axis: Analysis population: full versus explicitly described restricted samples

levels.description: All eligible TIGER-import counties, excluding Massachusetts
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: Closest-described full-sample origin; other restrictions change the population.

levels.description: Keep counties adjacent to at least one county of opposite treatment status
levels.label: non_equivalent
levels.rationale: Published restriction designed to address geographic clustering; different population.

levels.description: Keep counties scheduled for updates in calendar 2005 or 2006
levels.label: non_equivalent
levels.rationale: Published restriction designed to address early/late scheduling; different population.

levels.description: Require opposite-status adjacency for both treated and control counties
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: Detailed construction says counties neighboring the opposite treatment status.

levels.description: Restrict treated counties to those bordering a control; control retention rule remains unstated
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: Introduction describes treated counties only; cannot determine whether this is shorthand for the symmetric definition.

levels.description: Use ACS five-year records for the 2005–2011 years described by D03; extension outside that range unstated
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: Closest local source description; it does not cover all main-text endpoints.

levels.description: Use ACS five-year estimates 2009–2014 as described in §2.4.4; earlier endpoints remain unresolved
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: Documented conflicting source window, not a license to fabricate missing years.

axis: Zero handling for activity log outcomes

levels.description: Use ln(Y+1) for every nonnegative count
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: Explicit cross-sectional equation; closest fully specified common transform, applicability to DD remains uncertain.

levels.description: Replace Y=0 with 1, leave positive Y unchanged, then log
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: Literal reading of adding one for all zero values differs from ln(Y+1); not numerically equivalent.

levels.description: Count distinct user IDs within the analysis period and county
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: Direct conceptual definition; cannot reconstruct from quarterly distinct-user totals alone.

levels.description: Sum quarterly contributor counts over the analysis window
levels.label: uncertain
levels.source_locator: D01, PDF p. 15, §3.3.1 and Table 4 note; D51 (unpaginated)
levels.rationale: Text also says sum total across all quarters; repeated people can be counted multiple times, so estimand differs.

levels.description: Distant follow-on consists of building-related information
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: Most explicit variable definition.

levels.description: Distant follow-on includes amenities, parks and restaurants as well as buildings
levels.label: uncertain
levels.source_locator: D01, PDF p. 19, 22, Table 7 note and §4.3
levels.rationale: Interpretive examples broaden the definition; exact tags and relation to deposited fields unresolved.

levels.description: Estimate at county-address-pair level using log absolute route-length error
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: Explicit regression unit in the in-scope table.

levels.description: Average logged errors to county level before the cross-sectional regression
levels.label: non_equivalent
levels.rationale: Explicit earlier definition changes unit, implicit county weighting, and potentially the estimand.

levels.description: ln(abs(OSRM distance − Google distance))
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: Detailed definition specifies absolute difference first, then log.

levels.description: Interpret §3.5 log-difference as a difference of logged route distances
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: Sourced linguistic ambiguity only; sign/absolute value and zero handling are not specified by this phrase, so it is not an executable equivalent.

levels.description: Counts of new contributors who meet a minimum lifetime-activity percentile threshold
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: Text explicitly describes a minimum number of contributions.

levels.description: Separate contributor types associated with each labeled percentile, potentially disjoint groups
levels.label: uncertain
levels.rationale: Figure note says classified by percentile but does not define bins; not executable without further documentation.

levels.description: Use population density, household income and per-capita income quartiles
levels.label: equivalent
levels.source_locator: D01, PDF p. 15–16, 18, §3.3.1, Figure 5 note, Table 6 discussion
levels.rationale: Repeated main-text definition.

levels.description: Use population, household income and per-capita income quantiles
levels.label: uncertain
levels.source_locator: D02, PDF p. 11, Table D.3 note
levels.rationale: Supplement calls these the cross-sectional quantile effects but names population instead of density.

levels.description: County FE and common calendar-quarter FE
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: Baseline time-effects design.

levels.description: County FE and fully interacted density-quartile × quarter FE
levels.label: non_equivalent
levels.rationale: Explicitly reported differential-time robustness; changes residualization and identifying comparison.

axis: Unit and estimator for baseline activity effect

levels.description: County-quarter difference-in-differences with county and quarter fixed effects
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: Baseline within-county change comparison.

levels.description: County cross-section with controls and covariate quartile effects
levels.label: non_equivalent
levels.rationale: Explicit complementary identification strategy; county fixed effects cannot be retained and time aggregation differs.

levels.description: Assign treatment randomly at county level; draw mechanism and seed unstated
levels.label: equivalent
levels.rationale: Published placebo design; no invented number of draws or seed.

levels.description: Use county treatment status from the TIGER completion map
levels.label: non_equivalent
levels.source_locator: D01, PDF p. 10, 17, §2.4.2 and Table 5 note
levels.rationale: Actual-treatment baseline is a different test, not an interchangeable placebo realization.
